q: When is it legal to drive off the road to pass another vehicle?
choices: If the vehicle ahead is turning left
It is not legal under any conditions
If there are two or more one-way lanes

q: When a railroad crossing is not controlled, what is the speed limit when you are within 100 feet and cannot see for 400 feet in both directions?
choices: 15 mph
10 mph
25 mph

q: Which of the following is the proper procedure for parallel parking?
choices: Drive forward into the space without stopping
Stop next to the vehicle behind the open space, and then drive forward into the space
Stop next to the vehicle in front of the open space, and then back into the space

q: What speed should you be driving when entering onto a highway?
choices: At or near the speed of traffic
Faster than the speed of traffic
Slower than the speed of traffic

q: How many feet away should you switch from high beam to low beam headlights when approaching a vehicle coming towards you?
choices: 900 feet
500 feet
700 feet

q: Who can legally park next to a curb painted blue?
choices: Someone who is either picking up or dropping off passengers
A person who is disabled and has a special placard or vehicle license plate
A person who will only be parked for less than 15 minutes

q: What should you do when there is a school bus ahead that starts flashing yellow warning lights?
choices: Slow down and prepare to stop
Stop immediately and remain stopped
Cautiously pass the school bus on the left

q: Which of the following is a requirement of California's Basic Speed Law?
choices: Always drive the speed limit, regardless of conditions
Match your speed to that of your surrounding traffic
Never drive faster than is safe for current conditions

q: You must notify the DMV within 5 days, if you:
choices: Paint your vehicle a different color
Sell or transfer ownership of your vehicle
Receive a traffic violation

q: Which of the following is an example of a safe driving practice?
choices: Staring only at the middle of the road
Always keep your eyes moving to scan the surroundings
Using your high-beam headlights in the fog

q: What should you do when reaching an intersection where a person operating a motorized wheelchair has entered the crosswalk?
choices: Remain stopped behind the crosswalk line until the motorized wheelchair has safely finished crossing
Remain stopped until the motorized wheelchair is beyond the range of your vehicle
Assume right-of-way if the motorized wheelchair stops in the crosswalk

q: Which of the following is true about large trucks?
choices: They are more maneuverable than passenger vehicles
They have large blind spots, which makes it difficult for the truck driver to see other vehicles
They have powerful emergency brakes and can stop quickly

q: What is one of the most common causes of traffic collisions?
choices: Paying attention to your surroundings
Better traffic flow
Driver distractions

q: Any driver who willfully flees or attempts to evade law enforcement, during which a person is seriously injured, is subject to:
choices: Imprisonment in a state prison for up to seven years
A fine of less than $1,000
Attending an anger-management class

q: What should a driver do who is stopped at an intersection and wants to make a left turn?
choices: Turn immediately if there are no pedestrians
Take the right-of-way turn before oncoming traffic
Give the right-of-way to any approaching vehicle that is close enough to be dangerous

q: In addition to setting your parking brake, what should you do when parking on a hill?
choices: Make sure the front wheels are parallel to the road
Make sure your vehicle is in neutral
Make sure your vehicle is in park position or in gear

q: You are under 18 years of age and have had your license for eight months. You may drive:
choices: At any time
Between 5 a.m. and 11 p.m.
Between 7 a.m. and 8 p.m.

q: Where should you begin a left turn from a one-way street onto a one-way street?
choices: The lane closest to the center of the street
The far-left lane
You can turn from any lane

q: You are required to notify DMV by filing a Report of Traffic Accident (SR-1) form if:
choices: You allowed a licensed driver from another state to drive your vehicle
You were involved in a collision with more than $1,000 in damages
You failed to pay your registration fees

q: At what point during a rainfall are roads most slippery on a hot day?
choices: Immediately after it has stopped raining
For the first several minutes
When it has been raining for a few hours

q: What color curb does not allow vehicles to stop or park?
choices: Yellow
Red
White

q: What is indicated by two sets of double yellow lines spaced 2 feet or more apart?
choices: Lanes of traffic moving in the same direction
Barrier
Carpool/High-Occupancy (HOV) lane

q: A highway has a posted speed limit of 65 mph. What does this mean?
choices: You must always drive 65 mph on that highway
You may drive faster only if there are no other vehicles
You must drive 65 mph only if driving conditions are ideal

q: When is parking in a crosshatched (diagonal lines) area allowed?
choices: It is never allowed
If the area is at least twenty feet away from a railroad track
If labeled as a bicycle lane

q: What should you do if your cell phone rings and you do not have a hands-free device?
choices: Answer the call and keep it short
Do not answer and let it go to voicemail
Answer if you are stopped at a red light

q: If a traffic signal is green, but traffic is blocking the intersection, what should you do?
choices: Partially enter the intersection as allowed by traffic
Wait and do not enter the intersection until your vehicle can get completely across
Drive around the traffic on the shoulder

q: In which lane should you end your turn when making a right turn?
choices: Any lane free of traffic
The lane closest to the left edge of the road
The lane closest to the right edge of the road

q: When is it required for you to obey directions from a crossing guard?
choices: At all times
During school hours only
Only when children are present in front of a school

q: You are required to notify DMV by filing an SR-1 form if you were involved in a collision with:
choices: Any damage
An injury
More than $500 in damages

q: What should you do to make a right turn at an intersection with a bike lane?
choices: Merge into the bicycle lane before making the turn
Wait until the bicycle lane ends, then make the turn
Make the turn from your current lane and do not enter the bicycle lane

q: Which of the following should you do if you are being followed by a tailgater?
choices: Change lanes and allow the tailgater to pass
Tap your brakes to signal you are moving at a slower pace
Increase your speed to match the speed of the vehicle

q: When you are driving the speed limit, you can be given a speeding ticket:
choices: If road or weather conditions require a slower speed
Under no circumstances because it is always legal
Only if you are approaching a sharp curve

q: Which lights should be used if you are having trouble seeing other vehicles because of dust or smoke blowing across the roadway?
choices: Parking lights
Emergency lights
Headlights

q: What does a flashing yellow traffic signal light direct a driver to do?
choices: Stop and proceed when traffic allows
Slow down and proceed with caution
Stop and wait for a flashing green signal

q: What should you do if a pedestrian is still in the crosswalk after the DON'T WALK sign begins to flash and your light has turned green?
choices: Wait until the pedestrian is out of your path before proceeding
Wait until the pedestrian signals it is okay to proceed
Wait until the pedestrian has crossed completely

q: When is it legal for a person to drive with an opened alcoholic beverage container?
choices: If the container is under the front seat
If the container is in the trunk of the vehicle
If the container is in the glove compartment

q: Which of the following is illegal while driving?
choices: Wearing a headset or earplugs that covers both ears
Wearing a headset or earplugs that covers one ear
Using cruise control on residential streets

q: What should you do when traffic is slow and heavy, and you must cross railroad tracks before reaching the upcoming intersection?
choices: Begin crossing when the vehicle in front of you is crossing the tracks
Wait on the tracks until the stoplight turns green
Wait until you can completely cross the tracks before proceeding

q: You are driving on the freeway. The vehicle in front of you is a large truck. You should drive:
choices: Closely behind the truck in bad weather because the driver can see farther ahead
Farther behind the truck than you would for a passenger vehicle
No more than one car length behind so the driver can see you

q: Always stop before you cross railroad tracks when:
choices: You don't have room on the other side to completely cross the tracks
The railroad crossing is in a city with frequent train traffic
You transport two or more young children

q: When you tailgate other drivers (drive close to their rear bumper):
choices: You can frustrate the other drivers and make them angry
Your actions cannot result in a traffic citation
You help reduce traffic congestion

q: Should you always drive slower than other traffic?
choices: No, you can block traffic when you drive too slowly
Yes, it is a good defensive driving technique
Yes, it is always safer than driving faster

q: You see a signal person at a road construction site ahead. You should obey his or her instructions:
choices: Only if you see orange cones on the road ahead
Unless they conflict with existing signs, signals, or laws
At all times

q: When can you drive in a bike lane?
choices: During rush hour if there are no bicyclists
When you are within 200 feet of a cross street where you plan to turn right
When you want to pass a driver ahead who is turning right

q: You see a flashing yellow traffic signal at an upcoming intersection. The flashing yellow light means:
choices: Stop before entering the intersection as long as you can do so safely
Stop. Yield to all cross traffic before crossing
Slow down and cross the intersection carefully

q: There is no crosswalk and you see a pedestrian crossing your lane ahead. You should:
choices: Make eye contact and then pass him/her
Slow down as you pass him/her
Stop and let him/her finish crossing the street

q: A solid yellow line next to a broken yellow line means that vehicles:
choices: In both directions may pass
Next to the broken line may pass
Next to the solid line may pass

q: All of the following practices are dangerous to do while driving. Which of these is also illegal?
choices: Listening to music through headphones that cover both ears
Adjusting your outside mirrors
Transporting an unrestrained animal inside the vehicle

q: During the first 12 months of holding a provisional driver license, you are prohibited from driving without a licensed adult between:
choices: 10 p.m. and 6 a.m.
11 p.m. and 5 a.m.
Midnight and 5 a.m.

q: Under California law, what cell phone use is permitted for drivers under 18?
choices: Hands-free calls only
Hands-free calls and single-tap navigation
No cell phone use at all, except to call for emergency assistance

q: When passing a bicyclist on the road, what is the minimum clearance California law requires?
choices: Two feet
Three feet
Four feet

q: What does California law say about motorcycle lane splitting?
choices: It is illegal under all circumstances
It is legal only when traffic is completely stopped
It is legal

q: Under the Move Over and Slow Down law, which vehicles must you move over and slow down for when stopped with flashing lights?
choices: Only police vehicles and ambulances
Only fire engines and law enforcement vehicles
Stationary emergency vehicles and tow trucks displaying flashing amber lights

q: When is it legal to make a left turn against a red traffic signal in California?
choices: It is never legal
When turning from a one-way street onto another one-way street, after stopping and yielding
When turning from a two-way street onto a one-way street
